categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批论文聚焦 Agent 在仿真、芯片、游戏等长流程任务中如何可靠落地，以及模型压缩与多语种评测的补位。

articles.title: From 1D Benchmarks to Complex 3D Geometries: Can Agents Reliably Specify Problems for Automated PDE Simulation?
articles.zh: 从一维基准到复杂三维几何：Agent 能否可靠地为自动化 PDE 仿真描述问题？
articles.summary: 如果你指望 Agent 自动搭 PDE 仿真流程，这篇会告诉你，光"把问题说清楚"这一步在三维几何上就已经很不稳。
articles.author: Akshat Jani, Sakhinana Sagar Srinivas 等
articles.body: Turning an engineering request into a simulation requires consistent geometry, physics, boundary conditions, and numerical settings. Recent agent-assisted systems automate simulation setup, but successful execution alone does not establish whether the specification preserves the intended problem or correctly handles missing information. We study whether agents can reliably construct complete executable JSON specifications for automated geometry creation, meshing, PDE solving, and result export. Our workflow combines model extraction with deterministic scientific and capability checks, explicit clarification, and validated local patches that preserve unrelated accepted fields. We evaluate specification correctness, execution completion, and numerical verification separately. On 120 template-related requests, the full workflow achieves 98.3% correct first-turn specification and decision outcomes, compared with 92.5% for schema-assisted single shot and 82.5% for model-only: gains of 5.8 and 15.8 percentage points, respectively. It makes no false-ready decisions among the 42 requests requiring clarification or rejection. Component ablations identify contributions from scientific checks and conditional repair. Separate downstream studies cover 1D, 2D, and 3D steady and unsteady, linear and nonlinear problems, including flow and elasticity with complex three-dimensional wing geometries. A 30-case gallery demonstrates automated execution from retained JSON specifications, while 9 of 12 selected live user-to-results tests achieve joint specification, execution, export, and numerical-reference success (75.0%). These results support traceable, engineer-reviewed simulation assistance within the tested scope, while fresh-response regressions identify consistency as a priority for further improvement.
articles.bodyZh: 要把一个工程需求变成仿真(simulation)，就得让几何(geometry)、物理(physics)、边界条件(boundary conditions)和数值设置(numerical settings)都对得上。最近一些智能体辅助系统(agent-assisted systems)能自动搭仿真，但光能跑通，并不能说明这份规格有没有忠实保留原本要解决的问题，或者有没有正确处理缺失信息。我们研究的是：智能体能不能可靠地生成完整、可执行的 JSON 规格(specification)，用来自动建几何、划网格、解偏微分方程(PDE)、导出结果。我们的流程把模型抽取(model extraction)，和确定性的科学检查与能力检查(deterministic scientific and capability checks)、显式澄清(explicit clarification)，以及经过验证的局部补丁(validated local patches)结合起来；补丁只改该改的地方，已经接受、跟本次无关的字段保持不变。我们分别评估规格是否正确、执行是否跑完、数值结果是否通过验证。在 120 个和模板相关的请求上，完整流程首轮就能给出正确规格和决策结果的比例是 98.3%；模式辅助单次生成(schema-assisted single shot)是 92.5%，仅靠模型(model-only)是 82.5%，分别高出 5.8 和 15.8 个百分点。在 42 个需要澄清或拒绝的请求里，它没有做出任何“假就绪”决策(false-ready decisions)。组件消融(component ablations)显示，科学检查和条件修复(conditional repair)各自都有贡献。另外做的下游研究(downstream studies)覆盖一维、二维、三维，稳态和非稳态(steady and unsteady)，线性和非线性(linear and nonlinear)问题，包括带复杂三维机翼几何(three-dimensional wing geometries)的流动和弹性(flow and elasticity)问题。一个 30 个案例的展示库(30-case gallery)证明，保留下来的 JSON 规格能自动执行；在 12 个选定的真实“用户到结果”测试(live user-to-results tests)里，有 9 个同时做到规格、执行、导出和数值参考都成功，也就是 75.0%。这些结果说明，在测试范围内，这种可追溯、由工程师复核的仿真辅助是站得住的；不过全新响应回归(fresh-response regressions)也表明，一致性(consistency)是下一步最该优先改进的点。

articles.title: Rome Wasn't Built in One Turn: Replay-Grounded Reward Signals for Long-Horizon Freeciv Agents
articles.zh: 罗马不是一回合建成的：面向长时程 Freeciv Agent 的回放锚定奖励信号
articles.summary: 如果你在训练长时程策略游戏的 Agent，这篇提醒你奖励信号必须锚在真实回放轨迹上，否则稀疏反馈下模型根本学不动。
articles.author: Yanchen Liu, Xinyu Che 等
articles.body: Training language-model agents to play long-horizon strategy games is hard because deterministic feedback is sparse and often arrives only at the end of a game. In-game scores can offer dense signals, but they do not reliably predict future outcomes: in 8-68% of position pairs across eight strategy games, the higher-scoring position leads to the worse outcome. We term this phenomenon scoreboard traps. In Freeciv, an open-source turn-based empire-building game where several players manage units, cities, and diplomacy over hundreds of turns, we look into better reward signals for gameplay agents. To facilitate this, we build CivHarness, an open system that saves current game states, branches on different decisions, and replays the game to future turns to provide measurable long-horizon feedback from saved positions. We use CivHarness to train CivTelescope, an LLM Judge that predicts which one of two game positions will yield the better outcome. On scoreboard-trap pairs, CivTelescope is 1.3-2.0 times more accurate than off-the-shelf language models, and it generalizes to new game starts, later turns, and unseen rules. We then train a Freeciv gameplay agent with CivTelescope as a dense reward, and call this recipe CivMarshmallow. When used in the middle stage of the game where scoreboard traps are common, CivMarshmallow reaches an average training phase gain of 8.94 points, 77% more than the best baseline, the end-of-game reward. Over the full 120-turn game, CivMarshmallow uses a hybrid reward that starts from the scoreboard or the end-of-game reward and shifts to CivTelescope as the game advances; this hybrid reward scores highest among the rewards we compare.
articles.bodyZh: 训练语言模型智能体（language-model agents）去打长线策略游戏（long-horizon strategy games），难就难在：确定性的反馈（deterministic feedback）又少又稀，而且经常要等一整局打完才来。游戏内得分（in-game scores）能提供密集信号（dense signals），但它并不能可靠预测最后结果：在八款策略游戏里，有 8% 到 68% 的局面配对中，得分更高的那个局面反而会走向更差的结果。我们管这个现象叫“记分板陷阱”（scoreboard traps）。在 Freeciv 这款开源回合制帝国建设游戏里——几个玩家要在几百个回合里管单位、城市和外交——我们就想给游戏智能体找更好的奖励信号。为了做这件事，我们搭了 CivHarness，一个开放系统，能保存当前游戏状态、在不同决策上分叉，还能把游戏回放到之后的回合，从保存下来的局面里给出可测量的长线反馈。我们用 CivHarness 训练 CivTelescope，这是一个大语言模型裁判（LLM Judge），专门预测两个游戏局面里哪一个最后结果会更好。在记分板陷阱局面对上，CivTelescope 比现成语言模型准 1.3 到 2.0 倍，而且还能泛化到新开局、更往后的回合和没见过的规则。接着我们把 CivTelescope 当成密集奖励（dense reward）来训练一个 Freeciv 游戏智能体，这套配方叫 CivMarshmallow。在记分板陷阱很常见的中盘阶段用它，CivMarshmallow 平均训练阶段增益达到 8.94 分，比最好的基线——也就是游戏结束时的奖励——高出 77%。在完整 120 回合的对局里，CivMarshmallow 用的是混合奖励（hybrid reward）：一开始从记分板或终局奖励起步，随着游戏推进再切到 CivTelescope；在我们比较过的奖励里，这个混合奖励得分最高。

articles.title: MEMIG: Self-evolving Memory Construction for Antibody Optimization
articles.zh: MEMIG：面向抗体优化的自演化记忆构建
articles.summary: 如果你在做生物序列优化，这套会自我演化的记忆能把历史试错经验攒下来复用，不用每轮都从零开始猜。
articles.author: Yunhui Jang, Zach Wang 等
articles.body: Memory has become central to self-evolving LLM agents, which store and retrieve experience from past rollouts to guide future decisions. Existing systems represent this experience as free-form natural language and maintain it by rewriting, which fits tasks whose experience is narratable. However, in scientific discovery and optimization, experience is often a quantity measured by an oracle under a specific context. Rewriting it as text leaves no index for where a record should be, replaces a measurement with a description, and cannot express how interventions interact. To address this, we argue that agent memory for biomolecule optimization should instead be indexable, quantitative, and structured, and we introduce MEMIG. This memory construction framework realizes these three properties. In detail, MEMIG addresses each insight with a domain-grounded identifier and accumulates the quantitative effect measured by a property oracle, so that updates remain local and retrieval becomes an exact lookup. Next, MEMIG connects insights whose interventions are applied together and measures their epistasis by decomposing each evaluated set. Our results show that MEMIG improves performance in most settings across in silico antibody optimization tasks.
articles.bodyZh: 记忆已经成为自进化大语言模型智能体（self-evolving LLM agents）的核心能力：它们会存下并调取过去运行轨迹里的经验，用来指导之后的决策。现有系统把这些经验表示成自由形式的自然语言，再靠重写来维护，这适合那些经验能“讲故事”一样说清楚的任务。但在科学发现和优化里，经验往往是特定情境下由判定器（oracle）测出来的一个数值。把它改写成文字，就不知道记录该放哪儿，把测量值换成了描述，也表达不了不同干预之间怎么相互影响。为解决这个问题，我们认为，面向生物分子优化的智能体记忆应该可索引、可量化、结构化，于是提出了 MEMIG。这个记忆构建框架把这三条落到了实处。具体说，MEMIG 给每条洞见配一个有领域依据的标识符（domain-grounded identifier），并累积由属性判定器（property oracle）测出的量化效果，这样更新只发生在局部，检索也变成精确查找。接着，MEMIG 会把一起施加干预的洞见连起来，并通过拆解每个已评估集合来测量它们之间的上位效应（epistasis）。结果显示，在计算机模拟（in silico）抗体优化任务的大多数设置下，MEMIG 都能提升表现。

articles.title: Experts Exhibit Structured Redundancy: Structure-Preserving Expert Pruning for Mixture-of-Experts Large Language Models
articles.zh: 专家存在结构化冗余：面向 MoE 大模型的结构保持专家剪枝
articles.summary: 如果你要压缩 MoE 大模型，这篇说明专家冗余是按结构分布的，照着结构剪比无差别乱剪更能保住性能。
articles.author: Tian Wang, Yongding Tao 等
articles.body: Sparse MoE mechanism significantly improves the trade-off between model capacity and inference efficiency. However, practical deployment still requires storing all experts, resulting in substantial memory overhead. We show that expert outputs in MoE layers exhibit structured redundancy. Across different models and task categories, the stable rank and entropy effective rank of expert outputs are consistently far below the nominal number of experts, while expert output distributions also exhibit fewer effective modes. Motivated by these observations, we reformulate expert pruning as a structure-preserving expert subset selection problem and efficiently optimize it via a greedy strategy, rather than only independently scoring and ranking individual experts or exhaustively searching over expert combinations. We propose two expert pruning methods under the unified structure-preserving framework: Projection Energy Expert Pruning (PEEP), which preserves the functional subspace by maximizing weighted projection energy, and Distributional Coverage Expert Pruning (DCEP), which preserves the distributional geometry by minimizing weighted coverage error. Both methods incorporate router-derived weights as priors, enabling them to jointly preserve the global structural relationships among experts while accounting for the local importance of individual experts. Experiments on DeepSeek-V2-Lite and Qwen3-30B-A3B demonstrate that, at the expert retention ratios of 75% and 50%, our methods outperform the state-of-the-art baselines on the majority of benchmarks and consistently achieve the best average performance across both general tasks and mathematical reasoning tasks.
articles.bodyZh: 稀疏 MoE 机制（Sparse MoE mechanism）能明显改善模型容量和推理效率之间的平衡。但说白了，实际部署时还是得把所有专家全存下来，内存开销很大。我们发现，MoE 层里的专家输出存在结构化冗余。在不同模型和任务类别上，专家输出的稳定秩（stable rank）和熵有效秩（entropy effective rank）都一直远低于名义上的专家数量；同时，专家输出分布的有效模态（effective modes）也更少。受这些观察启发，我们把专家剪枝（expert pruning）重新表述成一个保留结构的专家子集选择问题（structure-preserving expert subset selection problem），并用贪心策略（greedy strategy）高效优化，而不是只对单个专家独立打分排序，或者把所有专家组合都穷举搜一遍。我们在统一的保留结构框架下提出两种专家剪枝方法：投影能量专家剪枝（Projection Energy Expert Pruning, PEEP），通过最大化加权投影能量来保留功能子空间；分布覆盖专家剪枝（Distributional Coverage Expert Pruning, DCEP），通过最小化加权覆盖误差来保留分布几何结构。两种方法都把路由器给出的权重（router-derived weights）当作先验，这样既能一起保留专家之间的全局结构关系，又能照顾到单个专家的局部重要性。在 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上的实验表明，在专家保留比例（expert retention ratios）为 75% 和 50% 时，我们的方法在大多数基准测试（benchmarks）上都超过了当前最先进的基线（state-of-the-art baselines），并且在通用任务和数学推理任务上都稳定取得最好的平均表现。

articles.title: TRIDENT and SHAKTI: A Framework and Benchmark for Hindi AI-Text Detection
articles.zh: TRIDENT 与 SHAKTI：面向印地语 AI 生成文本检测的框架与基准
articles.summary: 如果你只盯着英文 AI 文本检测，这篇提醒你低资源语种几乎是空白，现成检测器直接搬过去未必灵。
articles.author: Shifali Agrahari, Sujit Kumar 等
articles.body: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become increasingly multilingual, distinguishing human-written from AI-generated text is essential for maintaining information integrity. However, research remains English-centric, with limited benchmarks for low-resource languages such as Hindi. To address this gap, we introduce SHAKTI, a large-scale Hindi benchmark covering four genres, eight LLM families, multiple prompting strategies, and adversarial transformations. We evaluate its quality through human annotation and analyze linguistic, grammatical, and sentiment-based differences between human- and AI-generated texts. Building on these findings, we propose TRIDENT, a round-trip translation-based detection framework with three variants: TRIDENT-S (static threshold), TRIDENT-D (dynamic threshold), and TRIDENT-C (logistic regression using multi-distance RTT features). TRIDENT leverages semantic consistency between original and round-trip translated texts to identify AI-generated content. Extensive experiments show that TRIDENT outperforms conventional and supervised baselines, with TRIDENT-S achieving the best overall performance. Further evaluations across seven languages, adversarial settings, and unseen LLMs demonstrate its multilingual applicability and robustness, while highlighting sensitivity to the translation model.
articles.bodyZh: 随着大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）越来越“多语种”，怎么区分人写的文字和AI生成的文字，对维护信息完整性就变得很关键。可现有研究大多还是围着英语转，像印地语（Hindi）这类低资源语言（low-resource languages）能用的评测基准（benchmark）还很有限。为了补上这个缺口，我们推出了 SHAKTI——一个大规模印地语基准，覆盖四类文体（genres）、八个大模型系列（LLM families）、多种提示策略（prompting strategies），还包含对抗性变换（adversarial transformations）。我们通过人工标注（human annotation）来评估它的质量，并分析人类文本和AI文本在语言、语法和情感（sentiment-based）上的差异。基于这些发现，我们提出了 TRIDENT：一个基于往返翻译（round-trip translation）的检测框架，有三个版本——TRIDENT-S（静态阈值，static threshold）、TRIDENT-D（动态阈值，dynamic threshold）和 TRIDENT-C（用多距离往返翻译特征做逻辑回归，logistic regression）。TRIDENT 利用原文和往返翻译后文本之间的语义一致性（semantic consistency）来判断内容是不是AI生成的。大量实验表明，TRIDENT 比传统基线和有监督基线（supervised baselines）表现更好，其中 TRIDENT-S 综合表现最佳。我们还在七种语言、对抗场景和没见过的模型（unseen LLMs）上做了进一步评估，说明它有多语言适用性和稳健性，同时也暴露出它对翻译模型比较敏感。

articles.title: Coarse3D: Controllable and Faithful Sparse Structure Generation for Image-to-3D
articles.zh: Coarse3D：面向图像到三维的可控且忠实的稀疏结构生成
articles.summary: 如果你在做图生3D，这条路线是先出可控的稀疏结构再补细节，比一步到位更容易守住几何忠实度。
articles.author: Gaige Wang, Bowen Pan 等
articles.body: Coarse-to-fine 3D-native generation relies heavily on the first-stage sparse structure, which determines the global orientation and overall geometry for subsequent refinement. However, existing coarse generators suffer from two key limitations: their orientation is difficult to control due to ambiguous semantic canonicalization, and their structures are often inconsistent with input images due to weak 2D-3D grounding. We propose Coarse3D, a sparse-structure generation model that produces orientation-controllable and structurally faithful voxel geometry from arbitrary unposed images. Coarse3D introduces three designs: a first-frame anchored canonical space that aligns generation with the first input view while preserving object-centric normalization; a dual-tower DiT that couples generation with auxiliary feed-forward reconstruction to learn spatially grounded features; and spatial-prior guided attention that regularizes cross-attention with pixel-to-voxel correspondence. Coarse3D can directly replace the coarse stage of existing pipelines. Experiments show that it substantially improves sparse structure quality and consistently enhances final 3D generation, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
articles.bodyZh: 从粗到细的三维原生生成（Coarse-to-fine 3D-native generation）非常依赖第一阶段的稀疏结构，这个结构决定了后续精细化的全局朝向和整体几何形状。但现有的粗阶段生成器有两个明显短板：一是朝向不好控制，因为语义规范化（semantic canonicalization）本身有歧义；二是结构经常和输入图像对不上，因为二维到三维的 grounding 太弱。我们提出 Coarse3D，这是一个稀疏结构生成模型，能从任意未标定姿态的图像中生成朝向可控、结构忠实的体素几何（voxel geometry）。Coarse3D 有三个设计：第一，首帧锚定的规范化空间（first-frame anchored canonical space），让生成结果和第一张输入视角对齐，同时保留以物体为中心的归一化；第二，双塔 DiT，把生成和辅助的前馈重建耦合起来，学习有空间 grounding 的特征；第三，空间先验引导注意力（spatial-prior guided attention），用像素到体素的对应关系来正则化交叉注意力（cross-attention）。Coarse3D 可以直接替换现有流程里的粗阶段。实验表明，它大幅提升了稀疏结构质量，并且持续增强最终的三维生成效果，达到了当前最优性能。

articles.title: RTL-Interact: Training EDA-Interactive Models for Multi-Task RTL Design
articles.zh: RTL-Interact：为多任务 RTL 设计训练可交互 EDA 的模型
articles.summary: 如果你想让 LLM 真进芯片设计流程，这篇的关键是让它学会跟 EDA 工具来回交互，而不是一次性吐代码。
articles.author: Wenxuan Shi, Yaoyu Zhu 等
articles.body: Large language models offer a promising route to register-transfer-level (RTL) design, but reliable implementations require checking and revision based on electronic design automation (EDA) tools' feedback. Existing RTL-specialized models often lack learned interaction with such EDA tools or rely on separate generation and repair components. We introduce RTL-Interact, a multi-task post-training framework that trains a single RTL-specialized model to generate RTL, construct task-appropriate EDA checks, and revise implementations using tool feedback. The framework combines automatically constructed multi-task demonstrations with staged supervision from chain-of-thought to tool-integrated reasoning. We further introduce Pattern-Aware Policy Optimization (PAPO) for multi-task reinforcement learning. PAPO augments Group Relative Policy Optimization with correctness-gated rewards that favor concise successful checking while rewarding effective revision, and uses task grouping to preserve coverage across objectives. On CVDP, RTL-Interact-32B achieves 48.7% weighted Pass@1 and 68.9% Pass@5, surpassing its teacher model, DeepSeek-V3.2, while RTL-Interact-8B achieves 44.9% weighted Pass@1. Additionally, we show that PAPO can reduce average tool calls by 63.8% while improving Pass@1. Both models also outperform all RTL-specialized baselines on VerilogEval v2 and RTLLM v2, demonstrating the effectiveness of our method.
articles.bodyZh: 大语言模型（large language models）给寄存器传输级（register-transfer-level，RTL）设计带来了一条挺有希望的路，但真想把它做得靠谱，还得靠电子设计自动化（electronic design automation，EDA）工具给出的反馈来做检查和修改。现有的 RTL 专用模型往往没学会怎么跟这些 EDA 工具互动，要么就是把生成和修复拆成两个独立部件。我们提出 RTL-Interact，这是一个多任务后训练框架（multi-task post-training framework），训练单个 RTL 专用模型去生成 RTL、构造适合任务的 EDA 检查，并根据工具反馈修改实现。这个框架把自动构建的多任务演示，和从思维链（chain-of-thought）到工具集成推理（tool-integrated reasoning）的分阶段监督结合起来。我们还提出了面向多任务强化学习（multi-task reinforcement learning）的模式感知策略优化（Pattern-Aware Policy Optimization，PAPO）。PAPO 在组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization）的基础上，加入了正确性门控奖励（correctness-gated rewards）：既偏向简洁且成功的检查，又奖励有效的修改，同时用任务分组来保持各目标的覆盖。在 CVDP 上，RTL-Interact-32B 拿到 48.7% 的加权 Pass@1 和 68.9% 的 Pass@5，超过它的教师模型 DeepSeek-V3.2；RTL-Interact-8B 则拿到 44.9% 的加权 Pass@1。另外，我们展示 PAPO 能把平均工具调用次数减少 63.8%，同时提升 Pass@1。这两个模型在 VerilogEval v2 和 RTLLM v2 上也超过了所有 RTL 专用基线，说明我们的方法确实有效。

articles.title: Beyond Response Scoring: An AI-aware Cognitive Supervision Framework for Automated Mathematical Short Answer Grading
articles.zh: 超越答案打分：面向数学简答题自动评分的 AI 感知认知监督框架
articles.summary: 如果你在做自动批改，只比对最终答案远远不够，这篇给了一套盯学生推理过程的监督框架。
articles.author: Shengran Guo, Min Chi 等
articles.body: Transformer-based language models have achieved remarkable success in automated short answer grading (ASAG). However, current methods in ASAG struggle to comprehend, reason about and evaluate complex mathematical answers involving symbols and formulas. These score-only methods fail to generalize across diverse responses and skill states associated with identical scores. Moreover, they ignore the potential upward bias introduced by generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) usage in assessing students' performance and knowledge mastery. To address these limitations, we propose AICG (AI-aware Cognitive-supervised Grading), a two-branch multi-task framework. The first branch combines RoBERTa-based regression, ordinal, and classification heads for individual-answer grading. The second branch uses an expert-designed Q-matrix to associate responses with assessed skills and jointly predicts G-DINA-derived skill mastery and learning gain. Through the shared encoder, these skill-level targets provide cognitive supervision for answer grading beyond score labels. AICG further uses a Gen-AI detector, trained through supervised contrastive pretraining followed by linear classification, to estimate assistance probabilities and convert them into reliability weights, attenuating unreliable cognitive evidence during learning assessment. We conduct experiments on 49,402 instructor-graded responses spanning 19 academic semesters. Relative to RoBERTa regression, AICG reduces mean absolute error (MAE) by 50.3% and improves quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) from 0.798 to 0.927. Ablations identify Q-matrix-guided cognitive supervision as the primary source of improvement, while AI-aware weighting further reduces overall MAE by 4.2% over the unweighted cognitive model and consistently improves MAE and QWK across the four most recent post-Gen-AI semesters.
articles.bodyZh: 基于Transformer的语言模型（Transformer-based language models）在短答案自动评分（ASAG）上已经做得挺成功。不过，现在的ASAG方法还很难理解、推理和评估那些带符号和公式的复杂数学答案。这些“只打分”的方法，碰到各种各样的回答、以及同样分数背后其实对应不同技能掌握状态时，泛化能力就不够。而且，它们还忽略了生成式人工智能（Generative AI）用在评估学生表现和知识掌握时，可能带来的“分数往上偏”的偏差。为了解决这些问题，我们提出AICG（AI-aware Cognitive-supervised Grading，AI感知的认知监督评分），这是一个双分支多任务框架。第一个分支把基于RoBERTa的回归、有序回归和分类头结合起来，给单道回答打分。第二个分支用专家设计的Q矩阵（Q-matrix）把回答和要评估的技能对应起来，并联合预测由G-DINA模型推导出的技能掌握情况和学习增益。通过共享编码器，这些技能层面的目标就能在分数标签之外，为答案评分提供认知监督。AICG还用一个生成式AI检测器（Gen-AI detector）来估计“学生可能借助了AI”的概率，再把它转成可靠性权重；这个检测器先做有监督对比预训练，再做线性分类。这样一来，在学习评估中就能削弱那些不可靠的认知证据。我们在49,402份由教师评分的回答上做了实验，覆盖19个学期。相比RoBERTa回归，AICG把平均绝对误差（MAE）降低了50.3%，还把二次加权Kappa（QWK）从0.798提升到0.927。消融实验发现，Q矩阵引导的认知监督是提升效果的主要来源；而AI感知加权又比未加权的认知模型进一步把总体MAE降了4.2%，并且在最近四个生成式AI出现后的学期里，持续改善了MAE和QWK。
